newsitem.title: USA: New Mexico 750 MW coal-fired unit to start Thurs.
newsitem.headline: New Mexico 750 MW coal-fired unit to start Thurs.

text.p: The 750 megawatt (MW) unit 5 at the Four Corners coal-fired power plant in New Mexico was expected to restart Thursday after shutting down early Tuesday for repairs, sources familiar with the plant's operations said on Tuesday.
The repairs are being made to a leaking boiler tube.
The plant's other units, another at 750 MW and three smaller units, were said to be operating normally.
Four Corners is operated by Arizona Public Service Co, which owns units 1, 2 and 3 along with 15 percent of units 4 and 5.
Southern California Edison Co holds a 48 percent stake in units 4 and 5.
